## Description ### SavedInstances An addon that keeps track of the instance/raid lockouts saved against your characters, and related currencies and cooldowns. SavedInstances has the following features: * Tooltip display shows current lockouts and data for all your characters, and optionally expired lockouts * Secondary tooltip (per-lockout) shows lockout details including bosses available, lock status and time remaining, and can be linked into chat * Tracks the honor points and conquest points of all your characters, including weekly caps * Tracks seals, resources, money, and other useful currencies (configurable display) * Tracks weekly World Boss Loots * Tracks LFR bosses looted * Tracks holiday boss encounters ... com/SavedInstances/SavedInstances/issues) (** Bug reports in comments might not be seen) Translators: **[Apply localization here](http://www.wowace.com/addons/saved_instances/localization/)** Featured in **[Hearthcast Podcast #181](https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=http%253a%252f%252fhearthcast.com%252fdownload.php%253ffilename%253d2013-08-14_ep181.mp3)** ### Known Issues SavedInstances is pretty good, but it's still not quite perfect. World of Warcraft Forums

# Blacklist addon needs to be removed from game

WoW Classic Mists of Pandaria Classic Discussion

[Dylacat-2424754](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Dylacat-2424754) (Dylacat) August 8, 2023, 7:06pm 321

If you did it once, more than likely you will do it again. With there being such a huge player base, there should be a ton of groups available that do not use the Blacklist. What this all comes down to is respect for yourself AND other players. If people don’t want to play with you…well then find other people to play with. It’s that simple. Coming on here and whining about it isn’t going to make anyone feel sorry for you. Change your name, and start over. If it really was just a one time action, you will have zero problems. This is WORLD of Warcraft…not My Little Bubble of Warcraft. :black_heart:

1 Like

[Delus-3239946](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Delus-3239946) (Delus) August 8, 2023, 7:08pm 322
Just so everyone is aware, this poster is carrionosa, he did not steal an amani warbear and he is not from faerlina, he is a benediction player who got blacklisted for ninjaing items at the end of a dungeon so he could disenchant them

3 Likes

[Zalanii-3236576](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Zalanii-3236576) (Zalanii) August 8, 2023, 7:08pm 323

After some digging because he’s been spamming the bene discord and making multiple forum posts which only gets more attention…

He wasn’t even blacklisted on Bene for what he claims, his warlock was put on the BL for needing on every single item in CoS. He has been harassing people on the discord for over a month.

[Classic Blacklist add-on (ABUSIVE BEHAVIOR/HARASSMENT) - WotLK](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/classic-blacklist-add-on-abusive-behaviorharassment-wotlk/1622358/47) Mists of Pandaria Classic Discussion

> If it wasn’t for that “addon” or the abusive of the Bene Black list.

...

That must have been done in an effort to meet people or something, or maybe “recruiting to the server” was thought of as some odd way to forgiveness. Here’s one thread, there are many more posts:  
[Benediction is the BEST server US - WoW Classic / Wrath of the Lich King Classic Discussion - World of Warcraft Forums (blizzard.com)](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/benediction-is-the-best-server-us/1622503)

Editing to include a post from that thread. Note the word “police” showing that this does point to the same person who was going on about “policing” and “the PD” in this thread:

[Benediction is the BEST server US](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/benediction-is-the-best-server-us/1622503/18)

> As someone who’s been on the blacklist before. I’ve never had a problem finding groups for dungeons or raids period. The blacklist was created by players themselves to try and “police” the server, but do a terrible job at doing so.

...

When a doctor removes a tumor, he has to remove it all, otherwise it comes back and more aggressive.

I guess we didn’t fully remove it this time since it’s back and more aggressive.

[Hwanwok-13159](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Hwanwok-13159) (Hwanwok) August 8, 2023, 8:05pm 340

So what I gather here is OP did a ZA run in TBC with the bear SR’d in mind, completed the objective needed to get the said bear. Bear given to the OP and the OP bounced after receiving it. Raid leader probably wanted to clear the rest of the raid and so did the rest of the raid group and probably was like “WTF?” because trying to fill the last spot for the last two bosses might be difficult because of the lockout.

Either way, Suddenly dipping out after getting what you want or need just sounds like to me that you only care about yourself and yourself only while disregarding the amount of time that the group has to waste.
I get it, I’m one of those people who care about themself over others but I don’t randomly up and leave when I get an item that I have been looking for and waste other people time.

As for the addon it self, I don’t think it shouldn’t be banned, I can understand that there will be some people who will abuse it and will put you on for some weird reason because they simply don’t like you but at the same time it should stay.

We're currently in the ninth week of TBC Classic Anniversary Phase 2, with less than a month until the official launch of Phase 3.

Since the raid nerfs, players and guilds have become much more efficient at clearing raids, and the game's progression has become simpler. Players have more free time to reflect on the challenges they've faced throughout Phase 2 and what new content they hope to see in the next phase.

Judging from player comments and feedback in the community, some suggest gameplay updates, others suggest increasing reward mechanisms… Regardless of the suggestion, players' goal is to add content to TBC Anniversary that will keep them engaged and playing for a long time.

This article summarizes five of the most popular changes players hope to see in Phase 3:

## 1\. Titan Rune Dungeons

Players hope that Titan Rune Dungeons from WoW WoTLK Classic can also be added to TBC Anniversary Phase 3.

### Core Mechanics

Upon entering any level 80 Heroic Dungeon, a Mysterious Device will be placed at the entrance. All members of the party must interact with it and channel energy to activate the corresponding Titan Defense Protocol.

Once activated, all mobs and bosses within the dungeon will receive a permanent buff, significantly increasing their health or damage, and gaining a unique dungeon-specific affix.

Unlike the infinite stacks of Mythic+ in the retail version, Titan Rune Dungeons only have a few fixed, discrete difficulty tiers, perfectly aligning with the raid's opening schedule.

Many players have therefore suggested adding DST directly to TBC Classic Phase 3 shop, allowing players who urgently need the equipment but cannot farm it to obtain it through the shop at a high price.

Besides the high difficulty of obtaining it, making DST easier to acquire is also a consideration for dealing with the difficulty of Phase 3. Based on all the currently leaked information about Phase 3, the gameplay and dungeon difficulty are unlikely to be reduced further, and Dragonspine Trophy can handle all phases from P1 to P5, up to final completion.

In addition, it is suggested that Phase 2 and even Phase 1 exclusive gear be made available to vendors, making it easier for players to obtain previous gear to cope with BCC Anniversary Phase 3.

## 3\. Badge of Justice

According to official news, Badge of Justice will definitely be released along with WoW TBC Classic Anniversary Phase 4, but many players have expressed a desire for it to be released in Phase 3.

### Core Mechanics
Badge of Justice initially only dropped from 5-man heroic dungeons, but as the game progresses, with the arrival of Phase 4, all 10-man and 25-man raid bosses will also begin to drop it.

Accumulating a certain amount of Badge of Justice allows you to exchange it for powerful Tier 5 or Tier 6 gear or trinkets later in the game, such as **Icon of the Silver Crescent** and **Bloodlust Brooch** .

### Reasons for Adding

Firstly, Badge of Justice is available throughout the entire phase. The trinkets obtained from it provide an immediate boost to a player's strength in Phase 3 and can also fill resistance gaps in the equally challenging SC and TK dungeons.

Secondly, the unique mechanics of Badge of Justice encourage players to actively farm dungeons. Only by consistently running dungeons like Serpentshrine Cavern and Tempest Keep from start to finish can you accumulate more Badge of Justice and exchange it for more gear, materials, and experience.

## 4\. Joyous Journeys

Joyous Journeys is currently only available in Mists of Pandaria Classic. As a limited-time world event buff, its core effect is to directly increase all experience gained during adventures by 50%. It's an essential buff for early game progression and for creating new characters later in the game for rapid leveling.
